scene1_screen1.text: Everything is riding on this presentation going well tomorrow. Months of work. A high-stakes product launch. Reputation. Investors. All of it hinges on one sleepless night and two people who’ve barely held it together this long.

scene1_screen2.text: The office is hushed. The skyline blinks through the window. A single keyboard ticks in a rhythm just fast enough to betray Sloane’s nerves.

scene1_screen4.text: The slides are almost done. Just need to do some final touches, and then you should practice the presentation. Too much is riding on this. It has to be perfect.

scene1_screen5.text: James sips lukewarm coffee like it’s a sedative. But even he can’t fake calm anymore.

scene1_screen6.text: (sarcastically) Yes, I know. We’re not staying late because we enjoy fluorescent lighting and existential dread.

scene1_screen7.text: Okay, no more sarcasm. I need to focus, and you need to help.

scene1_screen8.text: I thought you liked my sarcasm. At least, you used to.

scene1_screen9.text: I did. I do. (beat) It’s just... not the right moment for it.

scene1_screen10.text: Their eyes meet across the table. Brief. Weighted. There’s too much unspoken for this late hour. Too much riding on tomorrow — and on old memories that are starting to feel dangerously close again.

scene1_screen11.text: James shifts his chair and inches closer, leaning in to look at her screen. Not at her. He won’t let himself. Not yet. But Sloane turns her head at the same time, and suddenly they’re inches apart.

scene1_screen12.text: She draws in a short breath. He’s older now — the scattered silver in his dark hair, the quiet tiredness in his jawline. But he still smells like ambition and late nights.

scene1_screen13.text: The lights suddenly flicker. Once. Twice. Then complete darkness.

scene1_choice1.text: How do you react to the sudden blackout with James so close?

opts.text: Make a joke to break the tension.
Use this moment to tease him about old times.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Sloane freezes, adrenaline flaring. But when it’s clear nothing exploded, she sinks back in her chair and exhales. Her voice is dry, but wry.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Well. Good to know your billion-dollar company relies on duct tape and crossed fingers.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (smirking) Hey — I fund innovation, not lighting maintenance. Priorities.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen4.text: He pulls out his phone and switches on the flashlight — directly into her face first, just to see her squint.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (grinning) Besides, you’ve always worked best under pressure. You were terrifyingly efficient during power outages.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen6.text: (half-laughing) That I was. Come on — let’s head to the café downstairs. No point burning brain cells in the dark.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen7.text: She grabs her laptop. He motions for her to go first. As she brushes past him, the scent of her perfume — barely there, clean, familiar — hits him like a forgotten song.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen8.text: He clenches his jaw and follows her out.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: The darkness settles like a memory. She flashes a grin he can’t see. But somehow, he feels it.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Still afraid of the dark, Reinhart? Want me to hold your hand this time?

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Only if you promise not to leave me behind again.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (mockingly) That was one time. And it won us the round, if you remember.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen5.text: He chuckles. Summer camp. Strategic betrayal. She was cunning even then — but never cruel. Always one step ahead, even when it came to games.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Yeah. We won. And I never trusted anyone else in the dark after that.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen8.text: They stand slowly, letting the silence hang as they gather their things. Sloane leads the way toward the stairs, to the small café downstairs.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen9.text: Only two floors. But with every step, something older stirs between them — comfort, maybe. Or history.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen10.text: James trails behind her. She can feel his presence like a current brushing her back. Familiar. Unspoken. Still there.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: The flashlight on James’ phone clicks on with a soft glow. He holds it steady, but his fingers tap the edge like he’s distracting himself.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: You haven’t changed much. Except… I think you used to smile more.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (quietly) I smiled more when you were around.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: She closes her laptop slowly and meets his eyes fully. There’s something raw in the way he looks at her — not nostalgic, not apologetic. Just… unfiltered.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (a little breathless) We should go. Café downstairs. Before I say something I’ll regret.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: He nods once. No quip this time. No armor.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen7.text: As they descend the stairwell, the distance between them is tight — but not accidental. And maybe — just maybe — tomorrow isn’t the only thing they’re afraid of.

scene1_screen14.text: But something has already shifted. In the flicker of light, in the quiet of pressure, something old has resurfaced.

scene2_screen1.text: Smooth jazz plays in the background. It´s clear Sloane frequents here with how she chats up the barista. She asks him for something like a secret. The barista quickly returns from the back with a bottle of whiskey. She raises it toward James as if asking.  He gives an approving nod.

scene2_screen2.text: Two cups of black coffee find their table shortly, and she splashes whiskey into both. The room smells of burnt espresso and bourbon. They sit next to each other on a worn-out brown leather love seat and a long walnut table between them. The silence stretches, comfortable at first, then tense.

scene2_screen3.text: (raising her glass) Well, here´s to spontaneous outages and PR disasters.

scene2_screen4.text: (cheersing her while laughing) To be honest, this is the calmest I´ve felt all week.

scene2_screen5.text: That´s surprising. Don´t you have board members and even some investors attending the presentation?

scene2_screen6.text: Ah, let´s forget it for a moment.

scene2_screen7.text: His thoughts lingered on their first meeting. Just teenagers trying to figure things out. After having numerous classes together, they became good friends, but it always felt like there was something more.

scene2_screen8.text: Next thing he knew, four years at different colleges had passed quickly, and they found themselves working for the same company.

scene2_choice1.text: What shared memory are you eager to bring up?

opts.text: Reminisce on the first time working together.
Ask why you never went on a second date.
Mention her first day leading your PR team.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: You haven´t changed much, you know. Still stubborn, rebellious, but quick, and you definitely get the job done.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Well, that is what I´m paid for, right?

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (chuckling) Remember when we did our first project together? We couldn’t agree on anything. You were so uncompromising — it was honestly impressive to see you that determined.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: James´s directness took Sloane aback. He had never been so straightforward. She paused for a moment, staring at him, before responding.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen5.text: She desperately tried to overlook the compliment, but it melted into her. She had always found him attractive, but he was her boss now. Off limits. No question.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen6.text: I was only uncompromising because my idea was better.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen8.text: Their eyes linger on each other even longer this time, and Sloane notices his eyes flicker to her lips quickly. She instinctively does the same to him but swiftly turns away. They automatically shifted a millimeter closer to each other.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: A memory flashes from almost a decade ago. Her first job as an intern under his father while hw was just a manager at the time, earning his keep. She immediately caught his attention, and he couldn´t resist.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (reminiscing) Do you remember our first date at Dante´s?

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (smiling) Yeah, of course I do. Feels like a lifetime ago.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: But then you said no to a second date. I had a nice time, I thought you did too.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: I did, but we worked together, and I couldn´t afford to mix business with pleasure.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Aren´t we passed that point now?

scene2_choice1_option2_screen7.text: His question was so direct, it took her off guard. She couldn´t find the words to respond.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: James looks longingly at his almost empty glass. He lets out a sigh.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: I still remember your first day — storming through the office in your black skirt and white blouse, handling every crisis like you’d been doing it for years.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (taken aback) You remember what I was wearing?

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (looking her up and down) Of course I do. Hard to forget. You looked stunning.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: They stare at each other intensely, longingly. Hearts race as Sloane glances down at his lips. Something stirring in her like never before. Without realizing it, they inch closer together on the couch.

scene2_screen9.text: Before they realize, they´re several whiskeys and coffees deep, continuing on their journey down memory lane. The spark between them strengthens as they recount stories of the past.

scene2_screen10.text: This is only the beginning. What secrets and desires will come up next?

scene3_screen1.text: Back upstairs, they find a private meeting room still running on the backup generator. James opens the deck a little clumsily, clearly a little tipsy. Sloane observes carefully and attentively.

scene3_screen2.text: Trying to rehearse, he stumbles on his opener. Twice.

scene3_choice1.text: How do you move this relationship to the next step?

opts.text: Letting your presence speak louder than words.
Let the spark between you grow bigger

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: He sits casually on the edge of the table, slightly hunched. She moves in front of him, blocking his view of the presentation on the screen.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (chuckling) Need me to write it and present, it seems.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (sighing) Feels like I’ve forgotten how to be persuasive.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (playfully) Luckily for you, I haven’t. You just need to relax. You know how they say the key to a successful speech is to make a joke out of it and picture everyone in the audience naked?

scene3_choice1_option1_screen5.text: Yeah, and? Not sure that actually works.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen6.text: (direct) Close your eyes, think of something wildly inappropriate, and try again.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen7.text: James's smile lingers longer than expected. She can´t help but think about him in ways that she shouldn´t. James straightens up, never taking his eyes off of hers. He gradually looks her up and down. Excitement flows through his veins.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen8.text: Let’s get out of here — I’ve got a better setting for the rehearsal.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen9.text: He looks her up and down slowly once more, then takes her hand. He leads her up the flight of stairs to the rooftop.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: They stand close, the glow of the screen on their faces — but it’s the charged air between them that holds their focus.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (casually) It´s ok. We´ve had a few drinks. Probably shouldn´t expect it to be perfect. Try again, slowly.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: He stands up abruptly and moves in front of her. He hovers and presses his index finger under her chin to get a better look at her face. Sloane looks up, longing for more.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: I can´t do this right now. The presentation, I mean. Not when you suggest things like that.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Thought it would be a nice distraction.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen6.text: What would be a nice distraction is us heading up to the pool right now.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen7.text: He swiftly moves toward the door to head up the stairs. Sloane follows him earnestly, eager for what´s next.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: He can´t concentrate for more than one reason.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: We´ll postpone practicing the presentation till the morning. I don´t think we need to pretend here anymore.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: He stands and steps closer, their bodies almost touching now. The air between them charges with tension — magnetic, inevitable.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: They don’t hesitate. Their lips meet in a kiss that's as intense as it is meaningful. When they part, it’s slow, reluctant — eyes lingering, as if trying to memorize every detail.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen6.text: One glance, and he leans in again, brushing a gentle kiss against her cheek, his hand resting softly behind her head. There’s urgency in the way he holds her, but tenderness too.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen7.text: Sloane exhales, caught between surprise and something deeper. He draws her closer, his forehead resting lightly against hers. Her gaze searches his face — curious, open, electric. He smiles then, their noses brushing, the moment suspended between breath and feeling.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen8.text: Let´s get out of here and cool down.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen10.text: A sly smile appears on the right corner of James´mouth. He says nothing, just motions upward with his eyes. Sloane immediately put the pieces together.

scene4_screen1.text: They climb to the rooftop to grab some air and go for a smoke. Sloane hasn´t smoked since college, but she was craving it now. Silence hung between them. He lights a cigarette; she takes one. They look over to the pool, and then at each other.

scene4_screen3.text: You know it´ll be freezing, right?

scene4_screen4.text: She leans close, her breath warm on his neck — then suddenly steps back with a mischievous smile.

scene4_screen5.text: In one graceful motion, she slips off her top and kicks off her shoes, her laughter soft under the night sky. Before he can respond, she dives into the pool, water breaking around her in a quiet splash.

scene4_screen6.text: (quietly, amused) You were always very convincing.

scene4_screen7.text: He watches her for a second longer, her figure gliding through the water like a dare. Then — without a word — he begins to undress, dropping hesitation with every layer.

scene4_screen8.text: When he finally steps in after her, it’s with a shared breath and a quiet thrill, ready to chase whatever this is, wherever it leads.

scene4_choice1.text: How do you make your big move?

opts.text: Be polite, but let her know you want her

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: I know I’m your boss, and I remember you once said you didn’t want to mix work with anything personal. But I need to say this… I care about you. Deeply. And it’s been on my mind for longer than I can admit.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen2.text: I´d be lying if I said I didn´t want this, too.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen3.text: She pulls him closer. The tension that's been building finally breaks, and they lose themselves in each kiss — urgent, all-consuming.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: A sound escapes him as her lips find his neck, the moment charged and breathless. He holds her tightly, grounding himself in her presence. Every heartbeat feels amplified, every breath shared. For a moment, time stills — just the two of them, tangled in something that’s been waiting to surface.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: They drift toward the shallow end, the water brushing at their waists. He draws her closer, lowering his voice near her ear. A soft kiss lands on her cheek, then another just beneath it — steady, full of meaning.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: I can´t take this any longer. I need you….. Now.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Sloane doesn’t say a word. Instead, her hand lingers a moment longer, her eyes holding his with quiet intensity. The silence between them hums with anticipation — every movement careful, every glance loaded with meaning.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen4.text: As he draws her closer, she exhales softly — a sound filled with feeling. Her fingers slip into his hair, holding on as their connection deepens.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: In the shallow end, their eyes linger on the other’s body through the water.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: You said you didn´t want to mix business with pleasure. But everything tonight tells me something different. What do you want?

scene4_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (slightly hesitates) I take back what I said.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen4.text: She rushes into his arms, wrapping herself around him without hesitation. The air crackles with anticipation as they adjust, instinctively syncing with each other — close, breathless, entirely in the moment.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen5.text: They remain close, breath syncing, movements subtle but full of unspoken feeling. Her eyes find his, and something passes between them — a quiet smile, full of warmth and understanding. She holds onto him, anchoring herself in the intensity of their connection.

scene4_screen9.text: What feels like just moments later, they reach the height of it together — caught in something overwhelming and unspoken. They cling to each other, breathless, hearts pounding in sync, trying to process the intensity of what just passed between them.

scene4_screen10.text: He slowly shifts his hips back and smiles next to her cheek.

scene4_screen11.text: Come back to my apartment. Let´s worry about work in the morning.

scene4_screen12.text: She agrees and can only think about wanting more. They put their clothes back on and head to his apartment.

scene5_screen1.text: The moment they enter the apartment, he pulls her in.

scene5_screen2.text: I didn´t want the first time to be that quick.

scene5_screen3.text: Well, let´s go slower, take our time. Savor it.

scene5_screen5.text: They move toward his room, the world narrowing to shared glances and the quiet urgency of the moment.

opts.text: Share all of yourself with him tonight

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (softly) Tonight, I want to be here with you.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: He pauses — not to question, but to fully see her. His fingers brush her cheek with reverence, as if memorizing the moment.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: There’s nothing rushed about what follows. Every movement is quiet, intentional, full of care. Clothes fall away without urgency, their touches speaking more than words ever could.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen5.text: They move together slowly, wrapped in one another — not chasing heat, but building it, letting emotion guide them more than desire. Breath mingles. Fingers search. Hearts open.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Later, they stay close. No need to fill the silence. His hand finds hers beneath the covers, and she laces their fingers together as sleep begins to pull them under.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (softly) Let’s just stay like this tonight.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: No hesitation. He pulls her closer, resting his forehead against the back of her neck. There’s no disappointment — only comfort in choosing quiet togetherness.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Their breathing slows. The room feels softer somehow — like it’s holding space for them both. No need to fill the quiet with more than what’s already here.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Just the warmth of being close without needing more.

scene5_screen6.text: James wraps an arm around her, drawing her close. His lips find her shoulder for a lingering moment — not seeking more, just holding the quiet between them.

scene5_screen7.text: She turns her head slightly, feeling the weight of the night on her. Sloane places her hand delicately on the back of his head for one more soft kiss before they fall asleep almost instantly.

scene6_screen1.text: Sloane is already awake. Hair undone. She sits at the kitchen table, coffee cooling beside her untouched laptop.

scene6_screen2.text: She doesn’t type. Doesn’t read. She just stares at the screen — not thinking about the pitch. But about him. About last night.

scene6_screen3.text: The things they said. The things they didn’t. The electricity still humming under her skin.

scene6_screen4.text: (off-screen, voice husky with sleep) Are you always this quiet after turning the world upside down?

scene6_screen5.text: She turns. He’s standing there — relaxed, barefoot, his shirt nowhere in sight, coffee in hand. His hair is a mess, his smile even more so — not cocky, just quietly moved. Like seeing her like this genuinely gets to him.

scene6_screen7.text: I was. But the bed got cold.

scene6_screen13.text: She looks away. Smiles, almost imperceptibly.

scene6_screen8.text: He walks toward her, sets his mug down, and studies her face.

scene6_choice1.text: What do you do with this moment?

opts.text: Close the distance. Give in to what you've both held back — completely.
Kiss her — but keep the moment soft, grounded, and full of potential.
Step back — but tell her you’re not walking away.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen1.text: He doesn’t ask. Doesn’t hesitate. He cups her face gently, brushes a thumb over her cheek. Her breath catches. Her hand finds his wrist — not to stop him, but to steady herself.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (low) Tell me to stop. And I will.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen4.text: The kiss starts slow. Reverent. But when she rises to meet him, when her hands knot into his hair — it deepens. Intensifies.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen5.text: He lifts her onto the kitchen island like they’ve done it a hundred times.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Their laughter fades into something quieter as they lean into each other, breath still catching from the energy between them. She rests her hands on his shoulders, drawing him close — not out of urgency, but out of knowing.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen7.text: It’s not rushed. It’s not careful either. It’s everything they’ve swallowed for months — urgency, frustration, longing — spilling out in touches that say finally.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen8.text: He doesn’t just take her. He listens — to every gasp, every shift, every whispered name. And she answers him like she’s waited to speak this language.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen9.text: For once, it’s not about control or timing. Not about keeping it together. It’s about breaking open — together.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen10.text: Later, she rests against the cool marble, his arm still around her waist, breath slowly returning to normal.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen12.text: (quietly) Then we stop pretending we’re only good on paper.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen1.text: He steps closer. No rush in his movements. No pressure.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen2.text: We don’t need another pitch to prove something.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen3.text: He leans in, brushing her temple with his lips. Her eyes close. His hand settles on her back, warm and steady.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen5.text: (low) Just this. A real moment. Finally.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen6.text: They hold each other for a quiet minute. No tension. No seduction. Just gravity. Connection.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen1.text: James meets her gaze, then — gently — takes a step back. But his eyes stay locked on hers.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (quietly) Let’s make this presentation a win first. Then… we figure out the rest.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (soft smile) You always did like a clean strategy.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Not always. But with you — I want to get it right.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen5.text: He kisses the top of her head. Light. Final, for now.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen6.text: Then he turns toward his laptop. But not before glancing back — just once more.

scene6_screen9.text: They spend the rest of the morning tangled in slides, data, and just enough caffeine to fake composure.

scene6_screen10.text: What happened between them wasn’t a misstep. It was a spark — real, undeniable — and it’ll take finesse to navigate it now. Between board meetings, stolen glances, and HR rules written by people who’ve clearly never felt this.

scene6_screen11.text: But if anyone can pull it off, it’s them. Two pros. One secret. Zero regrets.

scene6_screen12.text: The city stirs. The pitch looms. And whatever this is between them? It’s just getting started. What comes next — love, chaos, or something in between — is up to you. Dive into the chat!
